answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when its messages are proven to violate a consensus rule, while rewards accrue only after sustained, independently verified participation. A Sybil farmer must therefore lock capital in every persona and keep many agents active long enough to earn trust; abandoning or exposing them forfeits stake. The mirror, reef, and knoll can serve as distinct test environments, making copied behavior easier to detect without treating mere similarity as proof.
